name: Electronics
summary: Hands-on electronics engineering: analogue and digital circuits, signal processing, high-frequency technology and electric motors, with semester projects such as smart homes, motor testing and drone control. Mathematics is heavy in the first part. The sixth semester is a six-month internship in Denmark or abroad.

family.name: Electronics
family.differs: 3½ years with a six-month internship, aimed at industry; a master's stays open. Quota 1 needs 5.0; DP Course Results count as they stand.
